scope: Additive public-asset evidence recheck for already materialized required spawned subunits. It records public visual tiers but does not promote a Viewer asset without a stable, accessible and level/variant-verifiable source file.
game_version: Current public wiki pages consulted on 2026-09-20; no client build or asset hash is published.

sources.title: Druid/Bear
sources.limitations: Public page labels Bear visuals as L1-2, L3-4, L5 and L6, but it publishes no stable source-file hash or client build. Direct file-route retrieval was blocked by robots policy.

sources.title: Lava Hound/Lava Pup
sources.limitations: Public page identifies one Lava Pup info image, not a versioned or level-specific game asset. Direct file-route retrieval was blocked by robots policy.

sources.title: Yeti/Yetimite
sources.limitations: Public text describes visual changes through L8 and identifies gallery renders, but does not provide a stable per-level source file/hash or current client build. Direct file-route retrieval was blocked by robots policy.

sources.title: Ice Hound/Ice Pup
sources.limitations: Only concept designs and beta model/pose are publicly identified; this is not evidence for a current production Viewer asset.

sources.title: Super Hog Rider/Super Hog
sources.limitations: Public mechanics and stat table do not expose a stable Super Hog image file, hash, level tier or client version.

sources.title: Super Hog Rider/Super Rider
sources.limitations: Public page labels one Super Rider L10-15 info image and a gallery item, not a stable source file/hash or distinct level asset.

sources.title: Super Yeti/Electromite
sources.limitations: Public mechanics and stat table do not expose a stable Electromite image file, hash, level tier or client version.

known_uncertainties: A page-level image label, gallery description or visual-color text cannot identify a reproducible Renderer asset or its source bytes.
Public direct file routes were unavailable to this audit; no app asset is extracted, copied, inferred or substituted.
No subunit is promoted to asset-conformant status by this evidence.
conclusion: Public pages improve the documented visual inventory but do not supply source-verifiable Viewer assets. Lava Pup, Ice Pup, Yetimite, Druid Bear, Super Hog, Super Rider and Electromite remain non-conformant on the documented-asset axis until a stable public artifact or authorized application measurement is available.
